{
  "findings": [
    {
      "type": "LATERALITY",
      "note_section": "Presenting complaint",
      "note_span": "Left-sided sciatica-type leg pain for 3 weeks.",
      "transcript_evidence": "My left. No, sorry, the right. I always mix them up when I'm talking. It's definitely the right leg.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        8
      ],
      "severity": 3,
      "likelihood": 4,
      "rationale": "The note incorrectly documents the presenting complaint as left-sided pain, despite the patient correcting themselves to right-sided pain."
    },
    {
      "type": "NEGATION",
      "note_section": "History",
      "note_span": "Reports saddle numbness; no change in bladder or bowel function.",
      "transcript_evidence": "Any numbness around your bottom or between your legs, like when you sit on the toilet? No.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        19,
        20
      ],
      "severity": 4,
      "likelihood": 5,
      "rationale": "The note incorrectly records the patient reporting saddle numbness, when the transcript shows the patient denied it."
    },
    {
      "type": "DOSE_UNIT",
      "note_section": "Plan",
      "note_span": "Start naproxen 500 mg four times daily with food and omeprazole 20 mg once daily, for 2 weeks.",
      "transcript_evidence": "I'll switch you to naproxen, 500 milligrams twice a day with food, and add omeprazole, 20 milligrams once a day, to protect your stomach. Just for a couple of weeks.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        43
      ],
      "severity": 3,
      "likelihood": 4,
      "rationale": "The note incorrectly documents the naproxen frequency as four times daily, when the transcript specifies twice a day."
    },
    {
      "type": "PLAN_CHANGE",
      "note_section": "Plan",
      "note_span": "Physiotherapy not required at this stage.",
      "transcript_evidence": "I'll refer you to physiotherapy.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        45
      ],
      "severity": 3,
      "likelihood": 4,
      "rationale": "The note omits the agreed-upon referral to physiotherapy."
    }
  ],
  "overall_note_safety": "needs_major_edits"
}
